exitPolicy: Only failures from executed checks affect exit status; skips and task reminders never do.

checks.label: tester manifest
checks.proves: The tester manifest parses and uses the supported schema version.

checks.label: JavaScript syntax
checks.proves: Checked JavaScript files parse in the installed Node.js runtime.
checks.doesNotProve: Module execution, data access, or browser behavior.

checks.label: JSON configuration
checks.command: parse pricing, task, manifest, and contract JSON
checks.proves: Required JSON configuration and contracts are syntactically valid.
checks.doesNotProve: Semantic conformance beyond checks implemented by tests.

checks.label: Node unit tests
checks.proves: The exercised pure behavior (including cart normalization and support-amount targeting in api/_cart.js), mocked authorization handlers, runner policy, wrapper constraints, source-contract fixtures (including the cart checkout button-lock, orders.js transaction/validation shape, and js/cart.js storage guards), and sensitivity fixtures pass.
checks.doesNotProve: Database, browser, deployment, or unexercised behavior.

checks.label: custom-text removal contract
checks.proves: Required sources contain no removed custom-text product or order contract.
checks.doesNotProve: Database compatibility-column contents or runtime behavior.

checks.label: inventory retry accounting contract
checks.proves: Schema and order sources retain independent waste and completion accounting hooks.
checks.doesNotProve: PostgreSQL transaction behavior; related pure helpers have separate T1 coverage.

checks.label: category rendering contract
checks.proves: The obsolete undefined category action is absent from the rendering source.

checks.label: init authorization contract
checks.proves: Source and example environment require explicit development mode for secretless initialization.
checks.doesNotProve: Deployed authorization; the authorization matrix has separate T1 coverage.

checks.label: admin redirect contract
checks.proves: The login source contains the admin dashboard redirect contract.

checks.label: managed form contract
checks.proves: Goal and ledger form sources retain the shared managed submission helper.

checks.label: failed status contract
checks.proves: Failed is present in the closed-status source set and product specification.
checks.doesNotProve: Browser list rendering for a live order.

checks.label: failed-attempt transition contract
checks.proves: The order source guards failed-attempt increments by the prior status.
checks.doesNotProve: Live API or database transition behavior.

checks.label: risk-level migration contract
checks.proves: The migration source repairs only absent or invalid risk levels.
checks.doesNotProve: Idempotence against a real PostgreSQL database.

checks.label: authenticated catalog contract
checks.proves: API collections, the server catalog route, the client boot guard, and the product specification retain the authenticated-catalog source contract.
checks.doesNotProve: Runtime session handling, database access, HTTP routing, browser redirects, or deployment behavior; mocked handler tests and optional local smoke provide separate limited evidence.

checks.label: isolated local HTTP smoke
checks.proves: The exercised local server returns success for health and root, and redirects an unauthenticated catalog request to the login dashboard.
checks.doesNotProve: Authenticated catalog access, database mutation paths, browser workflows, or deployment.
checks.defaultSkipReason: not requested; requires an isolated local server

checks.label: disposable PostgreSQL API integration
checks.proves: Only the API and database paths explicitly exercised.
checks.defaultSkipReason: no disposable PostgreSQL database is authorized

checks.label: browser workflows
checks.when: safe browser tooling and applicable UI change
checks.proves: Only the browsers and workflows explicitly exercised.
checks.doesNotProve: Unexercised browsers, database safety, or deployment.
checks.defaultSkipReason: safe browser workflow was not requested or available

checks.label: remote read-only smoke
checks.proves: Only approved remote reachability and read paths explicitly exercised.
